instruction:
Could you run the quarterly pipeline touch-up for the account that contact005@example.com belongs to? The runbook rules apply.

Pipeline runbook (excerpt):
- The touch-up covers every opportunity of that account that is not yet won or lost.
- Opportunities at 100,000 or above move to stage 'Negotiation'; those below move to stage 'Proposal'.
- Opportunities at 120,000 or above additionally get agent 3 as their new owner.
- Change nothing else, and send no notifications for routine field changes.
expected_post_state: The account is 3 (via contact contact005@example.com). Expected updates over its not-won-or-lost opportunities: opp 1: stage=Proposal; opp 44: stage=Negotiation, owner_agent_id=3. All other opportunity fields and records unchanged; no mails, no events.

provenance.source_benchmark: Author-constructed (Phase 2b family X, crossed gates); surface style follows WorkBench (Styles et al., 2024) and the archetype-D/F instances
provenance.adaptation: Instance designed by the author to cross exactly two routing mechanisms (build decision IT-055): rule matrix on runtime outcomes (x1, D4xD1), read chain into heterogeneous updates (x2, D2xD3), plan-time rule matrix forcing a heterogeneous plan object (x3, D4xD3). Target sets are computed from the deterministic seed with import-time assertions. Paradigm implementations are reused unchanged from archetype F.
